title: AI configuration
description: Control {vendor} access, capability toggles, and usage visibility for every workspace in this agency.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can change AI settings.
secretBlurb: The full API key is never displayed after the initial paste. The UI only stores a 4-character masked suffix. Rotation is done by replacing the managed secret below.
baseBlurb: The current {vendor} base is {base} ({compat}). Change it via the deployment environment ({env}).
workspaceManagerBlurb: Workspace managers see a read-only status card at /w/<slug>/ai-settings — they can't change anything here, only see what the agency has configured.

form.providerDescriptionSuffix: The provider key is read from the deployment environment; we never display or store the full key in the database. If you later switch to a managed secret, the UI will show a masked suffix only.
form.featureSettingsDescription: The toggle below is the master switch. When disabled, every AI capability stops working across the agency — even if a capability is individually toggled on.
form.enableAiDescription: Master switch for the entire agency. Requires a configured provider key (environment or managed secret).
form.capabilitiesDescription: Each capability surfaces a button in the planning flow. Disabled capabilities stay hidden in the UI.
form.testConnectionDescription: Sends a 1-token ping to the provider. The result is stored as the last test status.
form.testFailed: Failed — check API key and base URL
form.usageDescription: Counts of AI requests by capability, agency-wide. Per-workspace breakdowns live on each workspace's AI status card.
form.noUsageDescription: Run your first AI request from a content brief to see this card fill in.

campaign_ideas.description: Generate 3-5 campaign ideas that ladder up to the active brief.

brief_improvement.description: Tighten a vague brief into a clear Hook → Main message → CTA structure.

caption_drafts.description: Draft a caption with platform-aware tone; editable before save.

platform_adaptation.description: Adapt a draft caption to a different channel (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X).

related_format_ideas.description: Suggest adjacent formats for a piece of content (carousel ↔ reel ↔ story).

completeness_check.description: Score how ready a brief is for creative handoff and flag the missing pieces.

managedSecret.description: The active key for this agency. A managed secret in the database takes priority; the environment key is the fallback. Master switch status: {status}.
managedSecret.backupTitle: Back up the AI encryption key
managedSecret.autoManagedDescriptionMiddle: is set in the environment, so the system auto-generated a 32-byte encryption key and stored it at
managedSecret.autoManagedDescriptionSuffix: . This file is the master key for every AI provider key stored in the database.
managedSecret.takeControlSuffix: in the deployment environment and restart the app. The environment variable takes priority over the file.
managedSecret.disabledUntilKey: AI features are disabled until a key is provided.
managedSecret.apiKeyDescription: The key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). Only the last 4 characters are shown after save.
managedSecret.removeDescription: Removes the managed secret. The agency falls back to the environment key on the next request.
managedSecret.removedSuccess: Managed secret removed. The agency is back on the environment key.
managedSecret.managedNote: Stored as an encrypted managed secret. The full key is never displayed after the initial paste.
managedSecret.environmentNote: The key lives in the deployment environment (MINIMAX_API_KEY). The UI cannot edit it.
managedSecret.warningFallback: Back it up — losing it locks out all stored AI keys.
managedSecret.devFallbackDescription: The encryption key is being derived from a constant in the source tree. This is fine for local development, but the key is recoverable from the repository. Do not deploy this configuration — set
managedSecret.savedWithSuffix: Managed secret saved · ends in …{suffix}. The page will refresh with the new status.

diagnostic.title: How AI works in this app
diagnostic.description: AI is live when all three prerequisites are satisfied, the agency master switch is on, and at least one capability is enabled. Otherwise, in-app AI buttons stay disabled. A read-only status link next to each content-page section header shows planners where to look.
diagnostic.killSwitchLabel: AI feature enabled in the deployment
diagnostic.killSwitchMissing: Not set. The AI_FEATURE_ENABLED environment variable is the operator-level kill switch.
diagnostic.killSwitchFix: Set AI_FEATURE_ENABLED=true in the deployment .env and restart the container.
diagnostic.envKeyLabel: Provider key in the deployment environment
diagnostic.envKeySet: MINIMAX_API_KEY is set. The key is never displayed after the initial paste.
diagnostic.envKeyFix: Set MINIMAX_API_KEY=<your-key> in the deployment .env and restart the container.
diagnostic.managedSecretLabel: Provider key stored for this agency
diagnostic.managedSecretMissing: No managed secret. Add one in the form above to override the environment key for this agency.
diagnostic.managedSecretFix: Paste your provider key in the form above. Only the last 4 characters are stored.
diagnostic.whereBody: On a content page (the planning detail screen), the AI assistance card sits next to the brief editor and offers 6 buttons: Generate campaign ideas, Improve brief, Draft caption, Adapt to platform, Related format ideas, and Check completeness. Each sends a 1-token-context prompt to the provider and returns a draft you can insert, replace, or copy.
diagnostic.whereLink: Open the AI section on a content page
diagnostic.runbookIntro: For operator-level help (rotate the key, switch the model, drain a stuck queue) see
diagnostic.runbookSuffix: in the repo. The docs/ directory is not served by the app, so this is a repo path, not a clickable URL.
diagnostic.blockedBody: The admin toggle in the database reads On, but the runtime is blocked because at least one prerequisite above is not met. Run buttons on the content detail page remain hidden until the block is lifted.
